notes.title: Temp fix for save issue (soon ish bug patch fixing it completly)
notes.notes:
I found the issue with saves today (been really busy with irl stuff and working on new game so took time to find time to do it)
It's that the antarctica treaty numbers in the save file includes decimals and then the game tries to convert it to a variable that can't handle decimals, causing a error and therefore stops the rest of the save being loaded in and the map from refreshing.

to fix it, simply go to the folder users/(your pc user name)/appdata/locallow/dafaultcompany/earthroyale

then choose what type of save to fix (Scenario,Paintmode or just saves) then choose the save, then go into the Antarcticatreaty text file and remove all decimal numbers (the game requires there to still be 4 numbers in there with a % dividing them, just no decimals).

after next bug patch that part of the save file will support having decimals and therefore all old save files will work again, this is just a quick temp fix to make your saves work now

notes.title: Development Update + V13 Event vote!
notes.notes:
Due to the time it has taken to develop what was considered V12.03, it will be changed to be considered V13.
The aim of V13 will be
*Updating paintmode (making it less confusing and updating UI Design)
*Reworking the score to give greater value to notible sites (Cities, Nuclear sites, World Wonders, Artificial islands)
*Changing/Updating the controls in the game (Splitting , and . zoom speed and scroll zoom speed to make scroll faster and more!)
*If time and able to adding some sound to the game!


As always with major updates there is a Event vote [url=https://strawpoll.com/polls/ajnEO192xZW]with Wave 1 out of 2 + finally is already live[/url]!

This time instead of only giving you 2 votes i'm testing out letting everyone rank each proposed event giving each one a score between 0 and 9.

 
Also the heavily hinted god mode / control over events is atm planned for V13.01 Instead of Earlier said V12.04 due to these changes.

notes.title: Help with culture map update?
notes.notes:
So, since this game now got players from all around the world (except Africa, where i sadly need the most help with this due to how hard i've had finding actual good reliable info on their cultures and how many cultures there can be in some areas of the continent and how a lot of the continent is just usually marked out as Arabic even though Arabic is more like a culture group and not one big culture)

i thought i'd ask for help in giving me info about smaller local cultures that's not included in the game culture map or maybe areas where the border between 2 cultures aren't correct.

You can use the culture map mode within the paint mode to see the entire culture map and any help with this is appreciated.

on top of this, if you could tell me places where you think the game needs more cities added or any specific cities you feel like are missing that would also be appreciated ^^

aaand now that the game got like 1700 different sub divisions added, if you find any mistakes among them like if they are outdated or the name is slightly miss spelled or a border between them doesn't fully make sense please do that too ^^ but keep in mind that in some places i needed to merge 1 or more sub divisions due to the in game provinces not being small enough or not 100% following the actual sub divisions

you can leave any info as a comment on this post, or you can join the games discord if it's more complicated info! thanks in advance ^^/liz
